tools.name: check_availability
tools.title: Check availability
tools.description: Check whether a new request can be taken now. Remote work (calls, online reservations) has a daily limit; on-the-ground work takes one job at a time. Returns open or full and when it reopens.

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.title: Check Japanese invoice registration
tools.description: Check whether a Japanese corporation is a registered Qualified Invoice Issuer (needed for consumption-tax credit). Accepts T + 13 digits or the 13-digit corporate number.

number.description: Invoice registration number (T1234567890123) or corporate number

tools.name: check_open
tools.title: Check if a restaurant is open
tools.description: Check whether a MARU Order restaurant is taking takeout orders now, its hours and whether it accepts JPYC with a discount.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.title: Japanese company profile
tools.description: One profile for a Japanese corporation from its 13-digit corporate number: registered name and address, invoice (tax) registration status, and listing, industry and capital if it files with EDINET.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.title: Get a restaurant menu
tools.description: Get a MARU Order restaurant's menu: categories, items with tax-included JPY prices, options (size, toppings), allergens and sold-out flags. Use list shop slugs from the maru://order/shops resource.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.title: Get request status
tools.description: Get the status of a request: received, quoted (price and how to pay), paid, in_progress, done (with result), cancelled or refunded.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List services in Japan
tools.description: List the services MARU Japan Hands provides in Japan (Japanese phone calls, restaurant and golf reservations, shopping proxy, on-site checks, interpreting, Osaka stays, home search and property viewings, app development), with prices in JPY, limits and what is not offered.

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.title: Look up a Japanese postcode
tools.description: Get the address for a 7-digit Japanese postcode, including large offices that have their own postcode.

tools.name: place_takeout_order
tools.title: Place a takeout order
tools.description: Place a takeout order. Returns an order number and a link. The customer pays at pickup at the counter, or opens the link to pay with JPYC (discounted). This tool never charges or moves money.

options.description: Group name -> list of chosen option names

pickup_time.description: Pickup time today in JST, HH:MM

contact.description: Phone or email for the shop to reach the customer

tools.name: quote_purchase
tools.title: Instant quote for buying in Japan
tools.description: Instant cost estimate to buy an item sold in Japan and ship it: item price (from the shop page the user or agent found), our fee (10%, minimum JPY 2,000) and shipping estimated from Japan Post's official EMS table. Read-only: it does not order or charge anything.

item_url.description: Product page URL in Japan (Rakuten, Amazon.co.jp, brand store, etc.)

item_price_jpy.description: Price per unit in JPY, tax included, as shown on the shop page

seller_shipping_jpy.description: Shop's shipping to our address in Japan, if any

ship_to_country.description: ISO 2-letter country code of the destination, e.g. US, TW, CN; JP for Japan

estimated_weight_kg.description: Item weight in kg if known (default 1.0)

tools.name: request_service
tools.title: Request a service in Japan
tools.description: Send a request for a service in Japan. Fixed-price services (phone_call JPY 1,500, restaurant_booking JPY 3,000, interpreting JPY 5,000 per 30 min) return the quote and payment details immediately. Other services get a fixed quote from a person within 2 hours (JST 09:00-21:00); requests sent outside hours are handled from 09:00. No email is needed: follow up with get_request_status. Creating a request is free and does not move any money. Full refund if we cannot do the task or you cancel before work starts.

details.description: What, where, when, how many people, names, constraints

contact_email.description: Optional email for the quote and result

callback_url.description: Optional public https URL that receives status updates as JSON

language.description: Preferred language for replies, e.g. en, ja, zh

tools.name: search_address
tools.title: Find a Japanese postcode by address
tools.description: Find postcodes by part of a Japanese address or an office name, e.g. 大阪市北区梅田.

text.description: Part of the address in Japanese

tools.name: search_company
tools.title: Search Japanese companies
tools.description: Search all ~5.8 million corporations registered in Japan by name (Japanese, partial match). Returns corporate number, address, type and whether it is closed. Use the corporate number with get_company_profile.

name.description: Company name or part of it, in Japanese, e.g. トヨタ自動車

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture filter in Japanese, e.g. 大阪府

tools.name: search_listed_companies
tools.title: Find listed Japanese companies
tools.description: Filter companies that file securities reports in Japan (EDINET) by industry (Japanese name, e.g. 不動産業, 輸送用機器) and minimum capital. Returns securities code and capital.

tools.name: search_osaka_stays
tools.description: 查大阪民宿及房型，无需凭证。参考起价不是最终报价。Search Osaka stays and room types; prices indicative.

tools.name: submit_osaka_booking_request
tools.description: 这是申请不是订成，不锁房、不收费。Home-booking 人工报价及代订。请把返回的专属链接私下交给客人保存，客人本人在该页确认报价后去 Home-booking 刷卡；邮件送达未核实，不可承诺一定收到邮件。绝不在工具里收款或收集卡号、护照。 Only after explicit guest consent to saving contact details and contacting the property. Reuse idempotencyKey on retries. No quote acceptance or checkout in this tool.

resources.title: MARU Order shop list
resources.description: Restaurants that take orders through MARU Order
